title: Simplify futility-pruning mate guards
rationale: Stockfish PR #7135 removes !is_loss(beta) and !is_win(eval) from the child-node futility-pruning condition. The upstream PR reports passing non-regression STC (51,520 games) and LTC (140,778 games). FayE's current search.cpp contained exactly these guards, so this was tested as a small isolated search change.

screen.decision: Advanced to confirmation because the screen was positive but imprecise.

combined_confirmations.decision: The independent repeat was exactly neutral and the combined evidence is only marginally positive, not credibly strong enough for promotion.

decision: NO-PROMOTION. Do not merge FAYE-0006 into the validated FayE baseline. Proceed to FAYE-0007.
notes: The initial 400-game screen was encouraging, but the signal attenuated substantially in two independent 1200-game confirmations.
No NNUE architecture, relational feature, time-management, or TT changes were part of this experiment.
Because the change is functional and can alter the search tree, raw NPS was not used as a promotion criterion.
